import sys
from pathlib import Path
import pytest
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
from proxy.tocp import ContinuationStore, ContinuationNotFound


def test_delete_owned_entry():
    s = ContinuationStore(ttl_seconds=30, max_entries=4, segment_chars=4)
    r = s.save("t", "s", "abcdefgh")
    assert s.delete(r.continuation_id, "t", "s") is True
    assert s.size == 0
    with pytest.raises(ContinuationNotFound):
        s.get_segment(r.continuation_id, "t", "s", 0)
    assert s.delete(r.continuation_id, "t", "s") is False


def test_delete_foreign_scope_is_refused():
    s = ContinuationStore(ttl_seconds=30, max_entries=4, segment_chars=4)
    r = s.save("t", "s", "abcdefgh")
    assert s.delete(r.continuation_id, "other", "s") is False
    assert s.delete(r.continuation_id, "t", "other") is False
    assert s.get_segment(r.continuation_id, "t", "s", 0) == "abcd"


def test_delete_unknown_and_expired():
    now = [0.0]
    s = ContinuationStore(ttl_seconds=10, max_entries=4, segment_chars=4, clock=lambda: now[0])
    assert s.delete("nope", "t", "s") is False
    r = s.save("t", "s", "abcd")
    now[0] = 11.0
    assert s.delete(r.continuation_id, "t", "s") is False
